issues.label: Statutory ground (c)(i) proof
issues.why: Court must determine whether clear and convincing evidence established that the conditions leading to adjudication continued to exist.

issues.label: 182-day time requirement under (c)(i)
issues.why: Ground (c)(i) requires that 182 or more days have elapsed since the initial dispositional order.

issues.label: Reasonable reunification efforts made
issues.why: DHHS must make reasonable efforts to reunify before termination, the central issue presented.

issues.label: Reasonable likelihood conditions rectified within reasonable time
issues.why: Ground (c)(i) requires no reasonable likelihood conditions will be rectified given the children's ages.

issues.label: ICWA compliance for removed child
issues.why: The middle child's removal under ICWA raises whether the other children may also be Indian children requiring ICWA protections.

issues.label: Applicability of ICWA to remaining children
issues.why: If siblings share heritage, ICWA's heightened standards and notice may apply to these children too.

issues.label: Best-interests determination
issues.why: Court must separately find termination is in each child's best interests by a preponderance.

issues.label: Individualized best-interests for each child
issues.why: Differing placements require separate best-interests analysis for each child.

issues.label: Relative/parent placement bearing on best interests
issues.why: Oldest child's placement with her father is a factor weighing against termination that must be considered.

issues.label: Accommodation of disabilities in services
issues.why: Psychological evaluation showing mental-health needs may trigger ADA duty to reasonably accommodate in service plan.

issues.label: Adequacy of substance abuse referrals
issues.why: Whether referrals to outpatient providers were reasonable given evaluation recommending inpatient treatment.

issues.label: Respondent's duty to participate/benefit
issues.why: Reasonable efforts require respondent to participate and benefit, not merely be offered services.

issues.label: Housing stability finding sufficiency
issues.why: Court must assess whether the disputed lease/housing determination was properly supported.

issues.label: Income and government assistance considerations
issues.why: Reliance on government assistance alone cannot be basis for termination and must be evaluated correctly.

issues.label: Validity of no-contest plea
issues.why: Whether respondent's plea to jurisdiction was knowing, voluntary, and properly supported by a factual basis.

issues.label: Contrary-to-welfare findings at removal
issues.why: Court must confirm proper findings justified removal and placement with DHHS.

issues.label: Standard of review on appeal
issues.why: Court must apply clear-error review to factual findings and statutory grounds.
